business_summary.text: Ksolves India Limited is a globally trusted IT services and solutions provider with expertise in AI/ML, Big Data, Cloud Computing, Salesforce, Odoo, Data Analytics, and DevOps.

call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth guided at 18-20% with EBITDA margins of 25-30%.
FY26 margins impacted by ₹1.1 Cr one-time labor regulation cost.
Halting further investment in DFM product to focus on core IT services.
Secured enterprise-grade Odoo win displacing SAP for a listed infra company.
Marketing and event expenses for DFM to reduce by 60% in FY27.
Geopolitical tensions in UAE caused some order delays in Q4.
Embedded AI across delivery with 80% of active engagements now carrying an AI component.
Q4 and FY26 results include a one-time ₹1.10 Cr impact from the new labour code.
Shifted from Time and Material to output-based engagements to drive higher client ROI.
Operationalized a three-pillar AI model covering 600+ AI-certified Ksolvers.

corporate_actions.subject: Annual General Meeting/Dividend - Rs 8 Per Share
Face Value Split (Sub-Division) - From Rs 10/- Per Share To Rs 5/- Per Share

guidance.statement: expect annual revenue growth to be around 18% to 20%

industry: Information Technology > IT - Software > Computers - Software & Consulting

operating_notes.text: Employee costs rose 26.5% YoY in FY26 to ₹80.4 Cr, impacting margins.
Board approved 4,000 ESOPs under KSOS-II scheme.
FY26 marked a structural shift as Ksolves embedded AI across delivery, execution, and client engagement.
Achieved 'Great Place to Work' certification in Q4FY26.
Recognized as a Salesforce Summit Partner for the third consecutive year.
Shifted to output-based engagement models from Time and Material.
80% of active engagements now carry an AI component.
Became a Frappe Certified Partner in 2026.
FY26 top 5 and top 10 clients contributed 40% and 54% of revenue respectively.
Everyone at Ksolves is now Claude-certified.
Declared 2nd Interim Dividend for FY 2026-27 of ₹1 per share.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹43.03 Cr (+29.1% YoY), net profit ₹9.69 Cr (+65.4% YoY).
Ksolves India reported record FY26 revenue of ₹162.7 Cr and transitioned to an AI-first operating model with 80% of engagements now AI-enabled.
Ksolves India reported FY26 revenue of ₹162.7 Cr and guided for 18-20% revenue growth in FY27 while pivoting to an AI-first operating model.
Ksolves India reported in Q2FY27 consolidated net profit at ₹7.25 Cr and declared a ₹1 per share interim dividend.
